frame.why.text: You are receiving this because of activity on your account or your place on the waitlist. We only send mail you asked for.
frame.why.description: Small print at the foot of most emails: why the person received it.

otp.subject.description: Email subject: the mail that carries a sign-in code.

otp.text.code.description: Plain-text sign-in email, first line. {{code}} is the six-digit code.

otp.html.code.description: Formatted sign-in email: the line above the code, which is set large underneath it.

otp.expiry.text: It expires in 10 minutes. If you did not request it, you can ignore this email.
otp.expiry.description: Sign-in email: the line under the code.

accountEmail.subject.description: Email subject: the code that links a new address to an existing account.

accountEmail.text.code.text: Your account email verification code is {{code}}.
accountEmail.text.code.description: Plain-text email linking an address to an account, first line. {{code}} is the six-digit code.

accountEmail.text.instructions.text: Enter it in Settings → Email & recovery to link this address to your account. It expires in 10 minutes. Never share this code. If you did not request this, ignore this email.
accountEmail.text.instructions.description: Plain-text email linking an address to an account: what to do with the code. "Settings → Email & recovery" names a screen in the app.

accountEmail.html.lead.text: Enter this code in Settings → Email & recovery to link this address to your account:
accountEmail.html.lead.description: Formatted email linking an address to an account: the line above the code. "Settings → Email & recovery" names a screen in the app.

accountEmail.html.expiry.text: It expires in 10 minutes. Never share this code. If you did not request this, ignore this email.
accountEmail.html.expiry.description: Formatted email linking an address to an account: the line under the code.

usernameChange.subject.description: Email subject: the code that confirms a username change on an account with no password.

usernameChange.text.code.text: Your code to confirm a username change is {{code}}.
usernameChange.text.code.description: Plain-text username change email, first line. {{code}} is the six-digit code.

usernameChange.text.instructions.text: Enter it in Settings, Account, Username. It expires in 10 minutes. Never share this code. If you did not ask to change your username, ignore this email and nothing will change.
usernameChange.text.instructions.description: Plain-text username change email: what to do with the code. "Settings, Account, Username" names a screen in the app.

usernameChange.html.lead.text: Enter this code in Settings, Account, Username to confirm your new username:
usernameChange.html.lead.description: Formatted username change email: the line above the code. "Settings, Account, Username" names a screen in the app.

usernameChange.html.expiry.text: It expires in 10 minutes. Never share this code. If you did not ask to change your username, ignore this email and nothing will change.
usernameChange.html.expiry.description: Formatted username change email: the line under the code.

waitlistJoined.subject.description: Email subject: the welcome to somebody who just joined the waitlist. Keep the emoji.

waitlistJoined.heading.description: Waitlist welcome email: the heading over the verification code.

waitlistJoined.text.code.text: Your verification code is {{code}}. It works for 15 minutes.
waitlistJoined.text.code.description: Plain-text waitlist welcome email, under its heading. {{code}} is the six-digit code.

waitlistJoined.html.codeLife.description: Formatted waitlist welcome email: the line under the verification code.

waitlistJoined.thanks.text: Thanks for joining the Homeroom waitlist.

waitlistJoined.expectation.text: We'll email you at this address as soon as your access is ready.
waitlistJoined.expectation.description: Waitlist welcome email: what happens next.

waitlistJoined.groups.text: Early access opens in small groups, with more groups opening on a rolling basis after that.
waitlistJoined.groups.description: Waitlist welcome email: how early access opens.

waitlistJoined.text.oneTap.description: Plain-text waitlist welcome email: the line above the confirmation link, which follows on its own line.

waitlistJoined.button.description: Waitlist welcome email, button: confirms the address.

waitlistCode.done.subject.text: Your Homeroom waitlist address is already confirmed
waitlistCode.done.subject.description: Email subject: somebody asked for a confirmation code, and their address needs none.

waitlistCode.done.asked.text: You asked for a new confirmation code for the Homeroom waitlist.
waitlistCode.done.asked.description: Email to an already confirmed address that asked for a code: the first line.

waitlistCode.done.nothingLeft.text: This address is already confirmed, so there is nothing left to do. You're on the list and we'll email you when your spot opens.
waitlistCode.done.nothingLeft.description: Email to an already confirmed address that asked for a code: the answer.

waitlistCode.done.status.description: Email to an already confirmed address that asked for a code: a link to their place on the waitlist. {{url}} is the link, and it comes last only if the sentence allows.

waitlistCode.status.subject.description: Email subject: a code that lets a confirmed person check their place on the waitlist.

waitlistCode.status.text.code.text: Your Homeroom waitlist status code is {{code}}. It works for 15 minutes.
waitlistCode.status.text.code.description: Plain-text waitlist status email, first line. {{code}} is the six-digit code.

waitlistCode.status.text.newest.text: Any earlier code has stopped working, so use this one.
waitlistCode.status.text.newest.description: Plain-text waitlist status email: under the code.

waitlistCode.status.text.enter.description: Plain-text waitlist status email: the line above the link where the code is entered, which follows on its own line.

waitlistCode.status.html.code.text: Your Homeroom waitlist status code is:
waitlistCode.status.html.code.description: Formatted waitlist status email: the line above the code, which is set large underneath it.

waitlistCode.status.html.life.text: It works for 15 minutes. Any earlier code has stopped working, so use this one.
waitlistCode.status.html.life.description: Formatted waitlist status email: the line under the code.

waitlistCode.status.button.description: Waitlist status email, button: opens the screen where the code is entered.

waitlistCode.status.ignore.text: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.
waitlistCode.status.ignore.description: Waitlist status email: the last line.

waitlistCode.confirm.subject.description: Email subject: a new code for confirming a waitlist address.

waitlistCode.confirm.text.code.text: Your Homeroom waitlist confirmation code is {{code}}. It works for 15 minutes.
waitlistCode.confirm.text.code.description: Plain-text waitlist confirmation code email, first line. {{code}} is the six-digit code.

waitlistCode.confirm.text.newest.text: Any earlier code has stopped working, so use this one.
waitlistCode.confirm.text.newest.description: Plain-text waitlist confirmation code email: under the code.

waitlistCode.confirm.text.oneTap.description: Plain-text waitlist confirmation code email: the line above the confirmation link, which follows on its own line.

waitlistCode.confirm.html.code.text: Your Homeroom waitlist confirmation code is:
waitlistCode.confirm.html.code.description: Formatted waitlist confirmation code email: the line above the code, which is set large underneath it.

waitlistCode.confirm.html.life.text: It works for 15 minutes. Any earlier code has stopped working, so use this one.
waitlistCode.confirm.html.life.description: Formatted waitlist confirmation code email: the line under the code.

waitlistCode.confirm.button.description: Waitlist confirmation code email, button: confirms the address.

waitlistCode.confirm.ignore.text: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.
waitlistCode.confirm.ignore.description: Waitlist confirmation code email: the last line.

waitlistReleased.subject.description: Email subject: the mail telling somebody their waitlist spot has opened.

waitlistReleased.preheader.text: Make and share apps with groups and friends. Here's how to get started.
waitlistReleased.preheader.description: The inbox preview line of the mail telling somebody their waitlist spot has opened.

waitlistReleased.text.opening.description: Plain-text "your spot has opened" email: the first line.

waitlistReleased.eyebrow.description: Formatted "your spot has opened" email: the small uppercase line over the headline.

waitlistReleased.headline.text: Make and share apps with groups and friends.
waitlistReleased.headline.description: "Your spot has opened" email: the headline, what Homeroom is for.

waitlistReleased.signIn.how.text: Your account now has access. Sign in with your waitlist email.
waitlistReleased.signIn.how.description: "Your spot has opened" email, to somebody who already has an account: what to do.

waitlistReleased.signIn.button.description: "Your spot has opened" email, button, to somebody who already has an account: opens the sign-in screen.

waitlistReleased.create.text.description: Plain-text "your spot has opened" email, to somebody with no account: the line above the link, which follows on its own line.

waitlistReleased.create.button.description: "Your spot has opened" email, button, to somebody with no account: opens sign-up.

waitlistReleased.codeNote.text: Opening it emails you a 6-digit code to sign in with. The code expires in 10 minutes.
waitlistReleased.codeNote.description: "Your spot has opened" email, under its link: warns that a second email with a code will arrive.

waitlistReleased.canDo.make.text: Make an app for your group
waitlistReleased.canDo.make.description: "Your spot has opened" email, list of what you can do inside: first item.

waitlistReleased.canDo.use.description: "Your spot has opened" email, list of what you can do inside: second item.

waitlistReleased.canDo.suggest.text: Suggest, preview and vote on changes
waitlistReleased.canDo.suggest.description: "Your spot has opened" email, list of what you can do inside: third item.

waitlistReleased.mobile.heading.description: "Your spot has opened" email: the heading over the phone install steps.

waitlistReleased.mobile.ios.text.text: iPhone: Install TestFlight, then open the Homeroom invite ({{link}}).
waitlistReleased.mobile.ios.text.description: Plain-text "your spot has opened" email: the iPhone install step. {{link}} is the store link. "TestFlight" and "iPhone" are product names.

waitlistReleased.mobile.ios.html.text: <0>iPhone</0>: Install TestFlight, then <1>open the Homeroom invite</1>.
waitlistReleased.mobile.ios.html.description: Formatted "your spot has opened" email: the iPhone install step. <0> is bold, <1> is the store link. "TestFlight" and "iPhone" are product names.

waitlistReleased.mobile.android.text.text: Android: Open the Homeroom testing link ({{link}}) while signed into Google Play with your waitlist email.
waitlistReleased.mobile.android.text.description: Plain-text "your spot has opened" email: the Android install step. {{link}} is the store link. "Android" and "Google Play" are product names.

waitlistReleased.mobile.android.html.text: <0>Android</0>: <1>Open the Homeroom testing link</1> while signed into Google Play with your waitlist email.
waitlistReleased.mobile.android.html.description: Formatted "your spot has opened" email: the Android install step. <0> is bold, <1> is the store link. "Android" and "Google Play" are product names.

waitlistReleased.signoff.text:
See you there,
Evan from Homeroom
waitlistReleased.signoff.description: "Your spot has opened" email: the sign-off, two lines. Evan is a person's name.

passwordReset.subject.description: Email subject: the link that sets a new password.

passwordReset.requested.text: Someone asked to reset the password for the Homeroom account with this email address.
passwordReset.requested.description: Password reset email: the first line.

passwordReset.link.description: Password reset email: the line carrying the link. {{url}} is the link itself, shown in full.

passwordReset.expiry.text: The link expires in 30 minutes and works once. If you did not request this, you can ignore it. Your password is unchanged.
passwordReset.expiry.description: Password reset email: the last line.
